title: Fix UI theme colors to ensure readable contrast between interface surfaces and text

requirements.text: Adjust the global theme color tokens so that interface surface colors (backgrounds, cards, popovers, borders, accents) are clearly distinguishable from text colors and provide consistent, readable contrast in both light and dark mode.

quotes: as cores da interface ficaram incompatíveis com as cores da fonte. refaça os ajustes nas cores corretas da interface do app para que sejam diferentes das cores da fonte.

acceptanceCriteria: Update the CSS variables in frontend/src/index.css for both :root (light) and .dark (dark) so that background/card/popover colors are not visually similar to foreground/card-foreground/popover-foreground text colors.
Body text (text-foreground on bg-background) meets WCAG AA contrast (>= 4.5:1) in both light and dark themes.
Muted text (text-muted-foreground) remains visibly distinct from normal text and remains readable on bg-background and bg-card in both light and dark themes.
Primary/secondary/accent button combinations using *-foreground variables remain readable (no cases where button text appears close to the button background color).

requirements.text: Audit and update key layout components/pages that use hard-coded color utility classes so they consistently rely on the theme tokens (background/foreground/card/muted/accent) and do not reintroduce low-contrast text-on-surface combinations.

quotes: as cores da interface ficaram incompatíveis com as cores da fonte. refaça os ajustes nas cores corretas da interface do app para que sejam diferentes das cores da fonte.

acceptanceCriteria: In the main app shell and authentication/landing layout (e.g., frontend/src/App.tsx), gradients/surfaces and text colors do not produce low-contrast combinations in either theme.
In shared layout components (e.g., header/footer), background and text utilities do not override the new token-based theme in a way that reduces readability (especially in dark mode).
No visible areas where headings/body text blend into their immediate container background (cards, headers, tables, panels) in both light and dark mode.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (they are read-only / must be composed, not modified).
Do not change backend logic or data models; this request is purely about UI colors and readability.
Keep the existing overall navy/white theme direction, but correct token values and usage to restore contrast.
nonGoals: Adding new features, routes, or backend endpoints.
Changing copy/translation content (i18n strings) beyond what is required for contrast fixes.
Redesigning layouts beyond what is necessary to correct color/contrast issues.
